system.description:
For each ally who dies during the story, add +1 Core Skill Point to a Core Skill of your choice for the rest of the story (maximum +3). If you are the last one left alive, also add +1 Talent Point to a chosen Core Skill.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.75
system.summary: For each ally who dies during the story, add +1 Core Skill Point to a Core Skill of your choice for the rest of the story (maximum +3). If you are the last one left alive, also add +1 Talent Point to a chosen Core Skill.

automation.note: Each time an ally dies this story, add +1 Core Skill Point to a Core Skill of your choice by adding a skillPoints rule to this ability (at most 3 in total). If you are the last one left alive, also add +1 Talent Point to a Core Skill of your choice. Remove these bonuses when the story ends.
